import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a bar plot comparing average sleep duration across different occupations
sns.barplot(data=df, x='Occupation', y='Sleep Duration', ci=None, palette='viridis')

# Set plot title and labels
plt.title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')

# Save the plot

```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a bar plot comparing average sleep duration across different occupations
sns.barplot(data=df, x='Occupation', y='Sleep Duration', ci=None, palette='viridis')

# Set plot title and labels
plt.title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
